notes.title: Update 20 (Demo will Come soon)
notes.notes:
[h1] Last Update before the Demo [/h1]

[b]We noticed an rise of Wishlists wich brought us to the Conclusion we should start the Demo we are still in Development but lets just say sometime in June and July.[/b]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]
[list]
[*] + Better Ui
[*] + Optimization
[*] + A lot of revamped Models and a lot of Placeholder are gone
[*] + Less Overgrown but bigger
[*] + More Music
[*] + Lower System Requirments
[*] + A lot of Technical Stuff
[*] + Fixed the Bug were u couldn't shoot straight
[*] + Fixed Enemy Navigation
[*] + Fixed Item Size Bug on drop
[*] - Multiplayer is not working for the forseeable future so we will remove it (maybe sometime later we put it in.
[*] - Some Unused Stuff has been removed
[*] - Broken Enemys have been Removed
[/list]

[h2]To be put in?[/h2]

[list]
[*] More Levels
[*] Even Better Ui
[*] Replace all Placeholder.
[/list]

[i]Ok till then[/i]

[b]Team Dark Admins[/b]
